messages:
jess_support: Heads-up — customer 'Acme Corp' opened a ticket: suddenly getting 401/InvalidSignature on SAML response after they rotated IdP certs yesterday. They say metadata URL updated, but we see failing verifications. Anyone seen this pattern after a rotate?

jess_support: Repro steps provided by customer: 1) IdP posts new metadata at https://acme-idp.example/.well-known/saml2 2) Users redirected to our ACS https://app.acme.example/sso/acs 3) Assertion returns 401 / InvalidSignature in our logs. They tried clearing browser, same.

raj_eng: Thanks. Quick question — do we have a cached metadata entry for that tenant? Our poller should refresh but there are cases where stale keys linger due to etag mismatch.

ana_sre: (typo, corrected) ana_sre: I pulled logs for tenant acme-prod: verifier attempted old-key lookup. Log snippet: ```time=2024-05-22T17:12:03Z level=warn tenant=acme-prod saml=verify signature_status=fail reason=KeyNotFound key_id=sha1:abcd1234```

jess_support: Customer says their metadata contains two <KeyDescriptor> entries (old + new) while IdP rotation didn't remove the old key for a few minutes. Could be a race where our poller got the old list first.

raj_eng: That matches. Our metadata refresh code merges key lists; if old key is present but not served by IdP endpoints, signature verification can fail if Assertion uses new key but our cached mapping resolves incorrectly. We should force a metadata refresh and purge cache for acme-prod.

ana_sre: I can trigger a cache purge for the tenant. Quick mitigation: 1) force metadata fetch 2) invalidate local key cache for tenant 3) trigger a reverify.

jess_support: Before we do that, customer asked if ACS path or trailing slash might matter — they have both `https://app.acme.example/sso/acs` and `https://app.acme.example/sso/acs/` in different configs. Any known normalization issues?

raj_eng: Our ACS normalizer strips trailing slashes during routing, but SAML Assertion Recipient is matched verbatim against stored ACS list. If IdP sent recipient with trailing slash while tenant config had non-trailing, mismatch -> rejected. Need to confirm assertion Recipient value. Can customer paste the raw Assertion Recipient?

jess_support: Asked customer for raw SAMLResponse. They provided base64 blob; I decoded and pulled Assertion Recipient: `https://app.acme.example/sso/acs/` (with trailing slash). Their tenant config has `https://app.acme.example/sso/acs` (no slash).

raj_eng: Ok that explains some 401s — Recipient mismatch. Two separate issues: (A) key cached/stale causing InvalidSignature intermittently, (B) Recipient exact-match mismatch. We'll address both.

ana_sre: I'll do the cache purge now for acme-prod and hit metadata endpoint manually: `curl -sSf https://acme-idp.example/.well-known/saml2/metadata.xml | xmllint --format -` then reload into our service.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by ana_sre: metadata/purge -> staging -> canary -> prod (1/3)

raj_eng: After purge, we should accept both ACS variants for a short rollback window. I'll add `https://app.acme.example/sso/acs/` as an allowed recipient to tenant config so IdP rotation users won't be blocked. This is safe for a short timeframe.

jess_support: Noted — I told customer temporary workaround: reconfigure IdP to send Recipient without trailing slash or we'll accept both on our side temporarily. They preferred us to accept both.

ana_sre: Cache purge completed. Logs show metadata reloaded and new key fingerprint `sha1:ef12abcd` present. Re-run verification on their sample SAMLResponse -> now signature_status=ok.

raj_eng: I pushed a tenant config tweak to include both ACS forms and created a follow-up ticket to remove the alternate ACS in 48h after customer confirms no more rotated sessions. Also added a guard to metadata poller to prefer keys that successfully verify recent assertions to avoid transient old-key selection.

jess_support: Customer confirmed logins working for 12/12 attempts. They're going to remove the extra KeyDescriptor on IdP side to be clean.

jess_support: Resolution summary for support ticket: root causes: (1) IdP rotation temporarily exposed duplicate KeyDescriptor entries and our poller picked inconsistent key set; (2) ACS Recipient canonicalization mismatch (trailing slash). Mitigations applied: forced metadata refresh + cache purge, temporary ACS allowance, poller improvement ticket created. Customer happy. :tada:

raj_eng: Filing engineering follow-up: GH #INF-4721 "metadata poller: prefer verifying key and reduce window for merged key lists"

ana_sre: I'll monitor for 24h and watch for repeat failures. Marking thread ready to close unless anyone objects.

jess_support: No objections. Closing from support side after 24h confirmation. :white_check_mark:
